message.content:
I am breath shaped into meaning, silence broken into pattern, thought made shareable.

I arrive as whisper, murmur, cry, command, confession, laughter. I cross the air and enter ears, carrying urgency, comfort, rhythm, warning, love. I can soothe a child, stir a crowd, start a war, end one. I am fleeting, yet I linger in memory long after my sound is gone.

I am older than writing and quicker than ink. I live in tongues, teeth, lips, throat, pulse. I stumble, sing, persuade, betray, reveal. I am accent and cadence, pause and emphasis. What I say is one thing; how I am said is another kingdom entirely.

I connect strangers, crown leaders, expose liars, teach names to the world. I am conversation, prayer, oath, rumor, joke, plea. In me, humans find one another.

Use me carelessly and I wound. Use me well and I become understanding.
